evals.prompt: Can you do an SEO audit of our SaaS website? We're getting about 2,000 organic visits/month but feel like we should be getting more. URL: https://example.com
evals.expected_output: Should check for product-marketing-context.md first. Should follow audit priority order. Should NOT report on schema markup based solely on web_fetch. Output should follow Audit Report Structure.
assertions: Follows audit priority order: crawlability first
Does NOT claim 'no schema found' based on web_fetch alone
Each finding has Issue, Impact, Evidence, Fix, and Priority

evals.prompt: We just migrated from WordPress to Next.js and our organic traffic dropped 40% in the last month. Help!
evals.expected_output: Should treat as urgent migration diagnostic. Check redirects, canonicals, robots.txt, sitemap. Provide prioritized recovery plan.
